name: Maximum Tree-Amalgams Have Representation Maps at Every Root
statement: Every member of $\mathfrak T$ admits a representation map rooted at each of its concepts and belongs to $\mathsf{MaxMin}$.
proof: Maximum classes admit a representation map at any prescribed root. Root flexibility is preserved by products and by the factor-tree one-point-amalgam theorem; the MaxMin product-amalgam theorem supplies a maximum parent.
